test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per the 75th NSS report, ______ has the lowest number of literate females in the state, with the female literacy percentage for the state pegged at 57.6%.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​Rajasthan** has the **lowest percentage of literate females **in the state, according to the **NSS report.**
 
• The state's estimated **female literacy rate is 57.6%**.
 
• **Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, and Jharkhand** are the other states in India with the** lowest percentages of female illiteracy.**
 
• When **female and male literacy rates** are combined, the state of **Rajasthan's overall literacy rate is 69.7%.**
 
• The state has an **80.8% literacy rate for men.**
 
• In** Andhra Pradesh,** the female literacy rate is** 59.5%.**
 
• **Andhra Pradesh** performs the worst in the nation in terms of male and overall literacy rates, with scores of** 66.4% and 73.4%**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The National Sample Survey** is headed by a **Director General.**
 
• It is in charge of conducting **nationwide, large-scale sample surveys** in a variety of subjects.
 
• Data are mostly gathered through **annual surveys of industries (ASI), household surveys** conducted around the country on **various socioeconomic topics, etc.**
